summary: Phaos Technology Holdings (Cayman) Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a change in its independent registered public accounting firm. The company dismissed Kreit Chiu CPA LLP and appointed AssentSure PAC as its new auditor, effective March 31, 2026. The change was approved by the audit committee and board. There were no disagreements or reportable events with the former auditor. This is a routine audit-related disclosure, not a special situation acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other corporate event.
